rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a very poor-quality early blastocyst with absent/degenerate ICM and TE consistent with 0DD; minor overreach in asserting specific features like necrosis/metabolic distress and thick zona not clearly demonstrable from the image alone.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometriosis, sperm parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status with the embryo’s poor morphology and overall prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and consistent, with prognosis appropriately driven by embryo quality; slight overstatement in calling the embryo essentially non-viable and inferring blastocyst yield/fertilization issues from limited data.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading and standard counseling, but some recommendations are more speculative or not routinely guideline-based (e.g., ERA, routine PGT-A implication at age 31, donor oocyte discussion after one more poor cycle, 'discard if any CC exists').

Provides clear counseling points and practical future-cycle considerations, including transfer expectations and protocol review; however, several suggestions are somewhat broad or speculative rather than tightly evidence-based for this exact case.
